date_note: Date is Coinbase's announcement of 24 November as reported by Crypto.news; the pages give no dates for the symposium itself.
title: Coinbase and US State Department co-sponsor Dublin symposium on North Korean crypto crime
summary: Crypto.news and The Currency Analytics report that Coinbase and the US State Department co-sponsored a two-day symposium in Dublin on North Korean crypto theft and IT workers using false identities. They say the FBI, FinCEN and Ireland's Garda National Cyber Crime Bureau took part, and that sessions covered spotting suspicious activity and when companies should report to law enforcement.
plain: Coinbase and the US State Department co-sponsored a two-day Dublin meeting on North Korean crypto theft and fake-identity IT workers, per two news reports.
exec: Authorities and companies are coordinating on North Korean crypto theft and fake-identity job applicants, per two news reports.

validation.note: Crypto.news and The Currency Analytics (two independent publishers) each state that Coinbase and the State Department organised the two-day Dublin symposium. Coinbase's own announcement was not read.
